author: Vobaseball12
body:
The title explains it all. What ideas do you have for rewards in a voting system? Also, suggest ideas for "Top Voter of the Month" as well as a reward for just voting one day.

I really hope this system gets implemented, and with more ideas, the higher possibility that this will be added.

Suggest away! :D

  • +chance to win X gadget in lobby (1/200)

replies.author: badgg
replies.body:
With the current credit system, it definitely supports a variety of voting capabilities... anything that rewards players for voting on their own free will would be beneficial.  

When I say their own free will ... I don't mean the servers that force you to vote to enable users to teleport, use world edit etc
